accueil.h1: Your AI film studio, open source, on ComfyUI.
accueil.sub: Write what you want to shoot, as a picture or a video, with your characters and places. Then scout, stage it in 3D, shoot and cut your film.
accueil.sub2: {n} ComfyUI tools on your own Comfy account, with a quote before every credit.
accueil.showLead: A character who keeps the same face from shot to shot, a set made from a text or a photo, a real place scouted on the map. All with ComfyUI models.
accueil.g1: One character, the same in every shot.
accueil.g1Alt: Close-up of Uttu, hooded, with golden veins
accueil.g2: A set, a light, a move.
accueil.g2Alt: A courier in a yellow jacket in an abandoned station, rays of light
accueil.g3: A real place, seen from above.
accueil.g3Alt: A Jura village and its Romanesque abbey at dawn, in the mist

bubble.name: One bubble, image or video
bubble.body: “What are we shooting?” Images with Flux Klein; video with MiniMax H3 when you attach references, LTX otherwise. From ≈ 2 credits estimated, quoted before sending.

refs.name: Named references
refs.body: A name and up to 3 photos, filed as Character, Set, Object or Style. Up to 7 references per creation.

angles.name: Angles and light
angles.body: Eight angles of a character (≈ 11 credits estimated) or a set (≈ 9), move the camera (≈ 3), light from your prompt (≈ 4) or copied from a picture (≈ 3).

video.name: Faithful video
video.body: True to your references with MiniMax H3 (≈ 4 credits estimated), FastH3 as second model to keep the place better (≈ 8). Faithful keyframes (≈ 14), style transition (≈ 7).

son.name: Sound for your video
son.body: Sound effects synced to the picture (≈ 15 credits estimated per 5 s block), voice and music split (≈ 1).

multicam.name: Multi-camera
multicam.body: Eight character angles, then one MiniMax H3 take on the angle you pick: ≈ 14 credits estimated for a first shot, then ≈ 4 per extra angle.

library.name: {n} tools, each with its quote
library.body: Create, retouch, video, 3D, sound. “Studio models only” hides tools that go through a paid partner service.

upload.name: Your files in original quality
upload.body: With your Comfy account connected: photos, videos and sounds up to 200 MB, deleted from storage once Comfy has them.

guide.name: Uttu, the studio agent
guide.body: Knows every tool and its cost, and suggests the right tool or the next step; you launch it. Through your Comfy account: ≈ 0.2 credits estimated per message at most.

creations.name: My creations
creations.body: Your projects stay on your device: ZIP export, and an Obsidian folder on a computer.

quote.name: A quote before every credit
quote.body: Every paid button shows its estimated credits and waits for your OK.

accueil.endTitle: Come in, and shoot your first shot.

trust.1: Your own Comfy account, no key kept by us

start.k: start begin first steps sign up getting started works guide
start.a: Pick a tool, or start with CAST to create your character. To run a render, tap “Sign in with Comfy”: the render runs on your Comfy Cloud account, and every button tells you ≈ how many credits it costs before it starts. The “Get started” guide below shows the 4 steps.

free.k: free pay paid money without paying trial
free.a: Image, video, sound and 3D renders run on your Comfy Cloud account and are paid in Comfy credits. Uttu, the estimator, touring the studio and scouting a place on the map launch no render. The studio charges nothing.

subscription.q: Do I need a Comfy subscription?
subscription.k: subscription standard plan tier pricing price monthly api
subscription.a: Yes, to run renders: they go through the Comfy Cloud API. According to Comfy’s pricing page, API access is included in plans from Standard up. Prices are on comfy.org/cloud/pricing: check them there, I don’t make any up.

credits.k: buy credits top up balance recharge
credits.a: Every Comfy Cloud subscription includes credits, and you can buy more at any time on your Comfy account (Settings → Plans & Credits). The studio doesn’t sell credits; your balance shows under “My credits” once your account is linked.

key.q: Where do I paste my API key?
key.k: api key paste link connect account token
key.a: Create a key on platform.comfy.org (API Keys → + New) and copy it right away: it is shown only once. Then tap “Connect my Comfy account” in the guide below and paste it.

keySafe.k: safe security key server share leak stolen
keySafe.a: Your key stays on this device; the studio doesn’t keep it on a server. Don’t share it with anyone. If it leaks, delete it on platform.comfy.org and create a new one.

cost.q: How much does a render cost?
cost.k: cost price how much credits expensive estimate
cost.a: Every tool shows its estimate before you confirm, in “credits estimated”. For a total, write for example “3 portraits + 2 LTX takes”, or open the estimator below.

estimate.k: estimated measured quote exact difference hypothesis
estimate.a: “Estimated” comes from the studio’s table, not yet measured on a real render. “Measured” comes from a render already billed. The exact quote shows in the tool, before you confirm.

cancel.k: cancel stop abort render job sent interrupt
cancel.a: Once a render is sent to Comfy, the studio never cancels it. If the page closes, “Recover the render” reads the job already sent, without starting a new one. A new render always needs its quote and your confirmation.

fail.k: failed failure error broken stuck render recover
fail.a: Open “Jobs and recovery” in the production plan: it shows the job’s state. Recovering reads the job already sent. Starting a new render always needs a new quote and your confirmation.

tabs.k: tabs steps organisation sections cast set take edit
tabs.a: The studio follows four steps: Cast (your characters), Set (your places), Take (your video shots) and Edit (you assemble and export). “Tools” gathers every Comfy tool by family.

bubble.q: Image or video: how do I create?
bubble.k: create bubble image picture video photo clip choose difference generate shoot
bubble.a: In “What are we shooting?”, pick Image or Video before you type. Image runs on Flux Klein. Video runs on MiniMax H3 when you attach references, otherwise on LTX. The quote “≈ X credits estimated” shows under the bubble before anything is sent. You can attach up to 7 visual references and, in Video, one sound.

refs.k: references reference named name character setting object style attach photos library same face
refs.a: A named reference is a name and up to 3 photos of the same subject, filed as Character, Setting, Object or Style. Create it from “References” in the bubble, then tap its card to attach it to your creation. It stays in your project and keeps the same face or place from one render to the next. For a video from references: “Reference-true video”. “Two pictures blended” (≈ 100 credits) stays behind “Change model”, only if asked.

prise5.q: How do I shoot a Take?
prise5.k: take shoot shot shots steps prepare preview generate review scene
prise5.a: A Take has 5 steps: 1. Prepare (character, set, action, mood, references); 2. Shots (build the list, tune the chosen shot); 3. Preview (check the framing before spending credits); 4. Generate (the quote first, then you confirm); 5. Review (keep the good version, run again or send it to Edit).

upload.q: How do I send my photos, videos or sounds?
upload.k: send upload import file files photo video sound audio original quality heavy size drop
upload.a: Drop them in the tool or in “References”. With your Comfy account connected, the file goes in original quality (up to 200 MB) to private storage, is handed to your Comfy account, then deleted from the storage. If that path is not available, your browser shrinks it before sending. Images, MP4, MOV or WebM videos and sounds are accepted.

finaliser.k: finish finalise finalize improve upscale sharp sharper quality 1080p remake regenerate
finaliser.a: Finish improves what exists and never remakes it: an image becomes sharper and twice as large, a take or the whole edit becomes larger and sharper. Acting, sound and timing stay. The quote shows first, estimated per 5-second block for video.

which.k: which tool tools pick choose need library family advice recommend angle angles camera multi-camera light relight sound split transition keyframes
which.a: An image: Quick image. Keep a character or place: Cast, Set, references. Other viewpoints: Eight character angles, Eight set angles, Move the camera. A video: the bubble in Video, or Take; with references: Reference-true video; two keyframes: Faithful keyframes; a changing style: Style transition. Multi-camera: Eight character angles, then “Shot, second engine” on the chosen angle: ≈ 14 credits, then ≈ 4 per extra angle. Retouch: Edit, Extend, Remove background, Larger and sharper, Relight (“Light from your prompt”, or “Studio portrait” as second model). Sound: Voice, Music, Sound effect, Sound effects for a video, Split voice and music.

projects.k: projects backup storage files saved device zip export obsidian vault folder
projects.a: Your projects are saved in this browser, on this device. You reopen them from “My creations”. Remember to download a backup: the browser can erase its data when space runs low. On a computer with Chrome or Edge, “Connect my Obsidian folder” also files your sheets and images in the folder you pick.

local.k: uttu works model ai intelligence local offline sends
local.a: I run in your browser with no AI model: I search a studio sheet built at every release. I send nothing and spend nothing.

who.k: who are you introduce name uttu
who.a: I’m Uttu, the U*TTU studio guide. I explain the steps, answer common questions and estimate costs. For an action in your project, I hand over to the production plan.

agent.k: agent paid comfy fuller free conversation future soon
agent.a: Yes: Comfy agent mode understands open-ended requests. It runs on your connected Comfy account, each message is paid by your account, and its estimated cost shows before the first send. The agent launches nothing: it suggests an action, you click. Without a linked account, only the cost simulator is available.

openWeights.k: open weights open partner proprietary hidden option settings
openWeights.a: A “partner” tool calls a paid proprietary model through Comfy. In your model settings you can keep only open models: partner tools are then hidden.

language.a: The language selector is in the top bar: English, français, Deutsch, español. The studio opens in English until you pick another language.
